definitions.explanation: A meeting to coordinate details, discuss plans, or make preparations before an event or project.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}からクライアントと{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせがある。
examples.english: I have a meeting with the client this afternoon.

examples.japanese: イベントの{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせをしましょう。
examples.english: Let's have a meeting about the event.

examples.japanese: {事前|じぜん}に{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせておいたおかげで、{本番|ほんばん}はスムーズだった。
examples.english: Thanks to the preliminary meeting, the actual event went smoothly.
examples.notes: {打|う}ち{合|あ}わせる as verb

notes:
FORMATION:
{打|う}つ (to strike) + {合|あ}わせる (to match/combine)

Literally 'striking together' → coordinating.

VERB FORMS:
・{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせる - to have a meeting, to coordinate
・{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせをする - to hold a meeting

COLLOCATIONS:
・{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせに{参加|さんか}する - to participate in a meeting
・{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ{時間|じかん} - meeting time
・{事前|じぜん}{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ - preliminary meeting
・オンライン{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ - online meeting

SIMILAR WORDS:
・ミーティング - meeting (more general)
・{会議|かいぎ} - meeting, conference (formal)
・{相談|そうだん} - consultation, discussion
